name: ct-dosing-errors-benchmark
description: Benchmark for detecting and classifying medication dosing errors in clinical text. It measures models' ability to identify incorrect dosages, frequencies, routes, or other dosing-related mistakes and to extract the correct dosing information from clinical notes. Useful for evaluating clinical NLP systems focused on medication-safety and information extraction.
reputation: Niche clinical-safety dataset with limited but growing use in medical NLP research.
